panel.title: 🎨 Loadout Lab
panel.text:
Need help finishing a loadout? Build it in the **CSFloat Loadout Lab** first, then click **Post a loadout** and paste its Share URL.

Tell the community what you're going for and what you need solved. Your post is titled `[Loadout] - Theme - Budget`.

fields.label: Primary theme or color
fields.description: Your post will be titled: [Loadout] - Theme - Budget

fields.label: Loadout Lab share link
fields.description: Build your inventory in CSFloat Loadout Lab, then paste the Share URL it generates.

fields.label: Your vision for the loadout
fields.description: What are you going for? Matching an Agent? Building around a pair of gloves?
fields.placeholder: I'm building around ... and want everything to match ...

fields.description: Clearly state what you need the community to solve.
